title: Tech Note: Compiling Cross-Platform with Plug-ins

historical_commentary.text: This note addresses the constraints of compiling 4D databases cross-platform (Mac/Windows) when third-party plug-ins built for the older, pre-modern 4D plugin API are involved; this exact class of Mac/Windows binary plug-in cross-compilation concern is tied to the classic 4D Compiler and legacy plugin architecture of the era and has limited direct applicability to modern 4D's build and plugin/component ecosystem.
related_updates: 4D's plugin architecture has evolved substantially since this era (through subsequent 4D Plugin SDK generations and eventually 4D components), changing how cross-platform plugin compatibility is handled
4D Transporter, the product this note is filed under, is a discontinued companion tool from 4D's classic-era product lineup
